evidence.quote: - In male and female rats, dulaglutide causes a dose-related and treatment-duration-dependent increase in the incidence of thyroid C-cell tumors (adenomas and carcinomas) after lifetime exposure. It is unknown whether TRULICITY causes thyroid C-cell tumors, including medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC), in humans as human relevance of dulaglutide-induced rodent thyroid C-cell tumors has not been determined.

response.reasoning: The claim states TRULICITY has no risk of thyroid tumors, but the label warns of a potential risk of thyroid C-cell tumors in animals and an unknown risk in humans, and includes contraindications related to thyroid cancer. Therefore the claim is contradicted by the label.
